fields.proposed_use: underwriting feature (self-reported, unverified unless paired with verification_status)
underwriting feature; also the basis for deriving scheduled_payments
treat with caution, do not default to including -- Milestone 2 decision
fields.leakage_concern: Circularity risk, not a timing leak: grade is LendingClub's OWN risk assessment, assigned at/before origination, so it is technically available at decision time, but using it as a model feature risks modeling LendingClub's own prior model rather than the borrower's underlying default risk.
Same circularity concern as grade, at finer granularity.
Largely a deterministic function of grade/sub_grade -- inherits the same circularity concern.

fields.proposed_use: TARGET SOURCE ONLY -- used to derive default_12m/delinquency_event_date, never an underwriting feature
fields.leakage_concern: This is the outcome being predicted. Using it as a feature is a direct label leak.
Cumulative amount paid to date -- only exists after origination, grows with elapsed time, and is strongly outcome-correlated.
Date of most recent payment -- does not exist until after origination and is strongly correlated with whether/when a loan stopped paying.
Amount of most recent payment -- post-origination.
Scheduled next payment date -- populated only for still-current loans, so its presence/absence alone leaks loan status.
Outstanding principal balance remaining -- a post-origination, time-varying quantity.

fields.proposed_use: exclude from underwriting features; candidate input to an illustrative LGD/EAD discussion only, never to a PD model
fields.leakage_concern: Only exists for loans that have already defaulted -- a direct post-default collections outcome.
Hardship-program enrollment is a post-origination servicing event triggered by observed repayment difficulty.
Debt settlement is a post-default resolution outcome.
A later, refreshed FICO pull taken during loan servicing -- reflects the borrower's credit state after origination, potentially after the loan has already shown distress.
Date of the most recent credit pull during servicing -- post-origination by definition.
